ValidationRule.description: Payment method change on an existing Opportunity: only cp_OpportunityPaymentMethod_Change (sales) or cp_AccountPaymentMethod_Change (Finance). Skips: first value, Account change (flow recalculates), sysadmin, miAPIIntegration.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't change the payment method of this opportunity. Ask Sales management or Finance (permission set miOpportunityPaymentMethod_Change).
